_meta.source_note: NIBE's own alarm-code search on nibe.eu is a Sitevision web app that reads its texts from this route; 'noah' is the S series and 'emmy' the F series. The answer is {"result": [{code, text, textLong, extraTextLong}]}. The Swedish strings below are NIBE's own, verbatim: only whitespace was normalised, plus one pilcrow (U+00B6, code 144) and one no-break space turned into a line break and a plain space.
_meta.coverage: Every code NIBE publishes for the S series (S1155, S1156, S1255, S1256, S320, S325, S735, SMO S40, VVM S320, VVM S325 and their accessories). It is the whole series, not just the S735, so codes for accessories a given house does not have can never appear.
_meta.text_confidence: High. `sv` is NIBE's own short display text, fetched verbatim. Where NIBE lists two wordings for one code (different boards) they are joined with ' / '.
_meta.severity_confidence: Derived, not published. NIBE's endpoint carries no severity field, so each code was classified by a rule over NIBE's own Swedish text: 'info' where the text says operation is unaffected or that the alarm clears itself, 'alarm' where it names larmdrift, hjalpdrift, blocked operation, a permanent alarm, or calling the installer, otherwise 'warning'. So `sv` and `action` are NIBE's words and `severity` is our reading of them: 174 alarm, 294 warning, 10 info.
_meta.action_note: `action` is the last sentence of NIBE's longer text that actually tells the owner to do something, quoted verbatim. Nothing here is written by us. 289 of 478 codes have such a sentence; the rest are null, which means 'we do not know', not 'do nothing'.
not_verified: The severity is not NIBE's -- see severity_confidence.
27 codes have no long text at NIBE and carry only the short one, so their severity rests on a handful of words.

Which register carries the number was taken from the register map in yozik04/nibe, not measured on a pump: 31976 'Alarm number' (s16) and 32196 'Class 1 alarm' (u8, 0=No alarm, 1=Alarm). 32196 is a flag, not an alarm reset -- the writable reset is 40023, which this app never touches.
F-series codes are not in this file.
